skill.name: testDanica Elemental Skill
skill.description:
testSwings her chain and anchor, dealing AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents and summoning an **Anchor** that follows the current on-field character's movements.

While the **Anchor** is present, it will assist in combat in different ways depending on whether Danica is on the field.
**When Danica is Off-Field**
When the current on-field character in the party hits opponents with Electro or Cryo attacks, the **Anchor** will launch a Coordinated Attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG at the opponents' location. This effect can trigger at most once every 1.5s.
**When Danica is On-Field**
Danica's Normal Attacks will be converted into Special Attacks using the anchor, dealing Electro DMG that cannot be overridden by infusion. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.

**Excitement**
While the Anchor is present, Danica can accumulate [[Excitement]] by performing anchor Special Normal Attacks or by having the current on-field character in the party hit opponents with Cryo or Electro attacks. When Excitement reaches its maximum, depending on whether Danica is on-field, all Excitement can be consumed to unleash different special Elemental Skills and enter the corresponding Maid Form:
**Defense Maid**
When Danica is off-field, switch to bring Danica on-field, automatically triggering [["Entry Skill E2"|Entry Skill E2]], and entering **Defense Maid**. Generates a Shield for the on-field character and refreshes the Anchor's Duration. During this time, **"On-Field Skill E2"** cannot be triggered.
**Battle Maid**
When Danica is on-field, the Elemental Skill will be replaced by [["On-Field Skill E2"|On-Field Skill E2]]. After using it, Danica enters **Battle Maid**. While in this state, after using "On-Field Skill E2", the anchor Special Normal Attacks can skip certain Normal Attack combo hits. During this time, **"Entry Skill E2"** cannot be triggered.

Additionally, when the Anchor disappears, Danica will exit the Maid Form. While the Anchor is present, Battle Maid and Defense Maid cannot coexist — upon entering one Maid Form, the other cannot be entered.

burst.name: Danica's Elemental Burst
burst.description:
test Commanding the battlefield with the poise of the Tsaritsa's handmaiden, launches a 5-hit wide-range attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG.

**Radiance: Stellar-Conduct:**
·The 1st and 5th hits additionally deal AoE Electro DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.
·For a period of time after use, if Danica is in Maid Mode, the current Maid Mode will be Enhanced, granting the corresponding Enhancement effect based on the current mode:
When Danica is in [[Defense Maid]] mode, increases ATK for all Characters in the party.
When Danica is in [[Battle Maid]] mode, immediately restores all Excited energy and increases the DMG dealt by Danica's **"On-Field Skill E2"**.

When Maid Mode ends, the Enhancement effect will be removed.

passive1.name: testAscension Talent 1
passive1.description:
test**Anchor** decreases the Electro RES of nearby enemies by 15%.

**Radiance: Stellar-Conduct:** Further decreases the Electro RES of nearby enemies by 15% and their Cryo RES by 30%.

passive2.name: Ascension Talent 2
passive2.description:
test After casting **「Entry Skill E2」**, Danica's own ATK increases by 20%.
After casting **「On-Field Skill E2」**, Danica's own ATK SPD increases by 20%, and when the Special Anchor's Normal Attack hits an enemy, she additionally gains 25 **Excited** points. The above effects can stack up to 3 times.
The above effects last until exiting the current Defense Maid or Battle Maid state. Re-triggering will refresh the Duration.

passive3.name: test Stellar Talent
passive3.description:
When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct, and party members' Base Stellar-Conduct DMG will be increased based on Danica's ATK: Every point of ATK she has increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.7%. The maximum increase that can be gained this way is 14%.
Additionally, when Danica is within a [[Polestar Field|@11330003]], she will enter the **Radiance: Stellar-Conduct** state.

otherPassives.name: Life Talent
otherPassives.description: test When your own Characters in the party are under the effect of Sheer Cold, Movement SPD increases by 10% and Stamina consumption decreases by 10%.

constellations.name: test C1
constellations.description:
testWhen Danica uses **"Entry Skill E2"** or **"On-Field Skill E2"**, she restores 20 Elemental Energy for herself. This effect can trigger at most once every 14 seconds.
Additionally, the [[Defense Maid]] enhancement effect in **Elemental Burst** is increased by 80%, and the [[Battle Maid]] enhancement effect is increased by 120%.

constellations.name: testC2
constellations.description:
While the test Anchor is present, Danica grants 7 stacks of "Toast" to all nearby Characters. When all nearby Characters have consumed a total of 6 stacks of "Toast", the active Character on the field additionally gains 1 stack of "Toast".
"Toast": When a party Character triggers a Stellar-Conduct reaction, 1 stack of "Toast" will be consumed, increasing the DMG dealt. This increase is equivalent to 100% of Danica's ATK.
Additionally, when Danica triggers a Stellar-Conduct reaction while in Battle Maid Mode, all current stacks of "Toast" she possesses will be consumed. Each stack increases the DMG dealt, with each increase equivalent to 150% of Danica's ATK.
Resummoning the Anchor or refreshing its Duration will reset the stacks of "Toast".

constellations.name: C3
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Elemental Burst** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: testC4
constellations.description:
test When the active on-field Character under the protection of Danica's Shield deals Stellar-Conduct DMG to opponents, regenerates 3 Elemental Energy for the other nearby party members. This effect can trigger at most once every 3.5s.
Additionally, when Danica enters the Battle Maid state, a Shield will also be generated. If Danica leaves the field while the Shield is active, it will be destroyed.

constellations.name: testC5
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Elemental Skill** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: test C6
constellations.description:
While the test anchor is present, the Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by nearby characters in the party is increased by 20%.
Additionally, when Danica enters the [[Defense Maid]] state, every 1,000 ATK Danica has increases the Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by the on-field character by 10%, up to a maximum of 40%.
When entering the [[Battle Maid]] state, every 500 ATK Danica has increases her own on-field Skill E2's CRIT Rate by 2.5% and the CRIT DMG dealt by 25%. CRIT Rate can be increased by up to 10% and CRIT DMG by up to 100%.
The above effects last until exiting the current Maid state.

glossary.name: Excitement
glossary.title: test Excited
glossary.description:
testWhile the anchor is present, Danica accumulates **Excitement**. Excitement can be gained in the following ways:
·When Danica is off-field, when the active Character on the team hits an enemy with Electro or Cryo attacks, 50 points are gained, triggered at most once every 0.1 seconds;
·When Danica is on-field, when the Special Anchor's Normal Attacks hit enemies, 25 points are gained, with Excitement gained this way at most once per Normal Attack hit.
Additionally, when Danica is in the **Defense Maid** state, Danica can only gain Excitement when the active Character on the team hits enemies with Electro or Cryo attacks; when in the **Combat Maid** state, Danica can only gain Excitement by landing hits with **Special Anchor Normal Attacks**.
When Excitement reaches the maximum of 100 points, Danica can consume all Excitement to unleash the special Elemental Skill **"Entry Skill E2"** or **"On-Field Skill E2"**, and enter the corresponding **Maid Form** based on how it is used.

glossary.name: Entry Skill E2
glossary.title: test"Entry Skill E2"
glossary.description:
testDanica swings her anchor chain to rapidly close in on enemies, then slams the anchor into the ground, dealing Electro DMG in an AoE, considered as Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.
After using this ability, Danica enters the **Guardian Maid** state, gaining the following effects:
·Refreshes the anchor's Duration;
·Generates a Shield for the current active Character in the party. The Shield lasts until the Guardian Maid state ends, and its DMG Absorption scales with Danica's ATK, with 250% effectiveness against Electro DMG.

glossary.name: On-Field Skill E2
glossary.title: test"On-Field Skill E2"
glossary.description:
testSwings the anchor chain to rapidly close in on enemies, then slams the ship anchor into the ground, dealing a large amount of AoE Electro DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.
After using this skill, Danica enters **Battle Maid** and gains the following effects: Each time "On-Field Skill E2" is used, the next round's **Special Anchor Normal Attack** will skip one Normal Attack stage, up to a maximum of skipping to the last Normal Attack stage.
After using **"On-Field Skill E2"** 5 times, Danica will exit **Battle Maid** and destroy the ship anchor.

glossary.name: Defense Maid
glossary.title: testDefense Maid
glossary.description: testThe state Danica enters after using her special Elemental Skill **"Entry Skill E2"**. While in this state, she provides a Shield to the active Character on the field and refreshes the Duration of **Ship Anchor**.

glossary.name: Battle Maid
glossary.title: test Battle Maid
glossary.description: testThe state Danica enters after using the special Elemental Skill **"On-Field Skill E2"**. While in this state, each time "On-Field Skill E2" is used, the Special Anchor's Normal Attack will Jump over a Normal Attack stage, skipping up to the first three Normal Attack stages.
